scope_decision.constrained_profile: Correctness, resources, stability, UI and ingestion; report latency without a reference-profile promise.
scope_decision.bulk_and_cold: Completion within execution guards, not the interactive latency gates.

limits.watchdog_scope: Entire worker, including preparation, independent verification and synchronous product cleanup. Expiry is not an operation latency.

fixture_definition.direction: alternate within each conversation; dominant ends with creator, other 100 end with participant
fixture_definition.tied_time: chat-1 last creator and participant messages share the latest timestamp; chat-1 is undetermined
fixture_definition.pagination: 50 plus 50; old cursor must fail after a committed edit and new publication

measurement.previous_protocol: Legacy whole-process mutation diagnostic, 1800 seconds including preparation and per-phase oracle work.
measurement.change: Record activation, observed question visibility, cleanup and backlog separately; persist operation and verification separately. Question fixture construction and fresh-runtime startup remain inside one 1800-second owned process-tree guard.
measurement.stale_reference_check: Timed after durable canonical mutation and before schedule, as in the legacy matrix.
measurement.cold_readiness: Ordinary projection_is_current before observing the first visible question; included in cold/unchanged operation clocks.
measurement.restart: New interpreter after scheduler join; process IDs and independent instances are recorded.
measurement.fixture_kind_boundary: Known synthetic event kinds only test query mechanics. Production unknown kinds remain unknown. Neither source fixture qualifies packaged ingestion.
measurement.resource_scope: The new supervisor samples the owned process tree, not only the main worker. Minimum available memory is 2 GiB throughout. These are new protocol records, not paired attribution of legacy timings.
measurement.visibility_poll_guard: Poll until a current answer is observed or the whole-worker guard ends. Bulk work has no ten-second polling cutoff.
measurement.windows_shutdown: v3 waits for owned process handles to become signaled as well as zero active job accounting. One ten-second shutdown deadline. The v2 CI shutdown failure and source diagnostic failures remain failures; they are not requalified by this correction.
measurement.reporting: v3 validates question plans without starting the application. Reporting errors preserve worker exit, ownership, clocks, raw payload and attachments; previous malformed summaries remain failed.

freeze_decision: Commit 1 closure instruction: reference-only numeric latency gates; constrained profile reports actual latency; no automatic sixth performance pass.
